evidence.note: Reformulates chart question answering as a chain in which every reasoning step carries a predicted image region, trains that pairing through a curriculum graded by nesting depth, and finds explicit intermediate grounding worth 8.78 points over letting the model attend implicitly.
evidence.title: CURV: Enhancing Chart Understanding Through Curriculum Visual Grounded Reasoning

evidence.note: Generates financial reasoning benchmarks from executable computation trees over real tables so that answers are correct by construction with no model in the labelling loop, exposes four independently controllable difficulty axes, and finds that unit and scale perturbations collapse the strongest model from 98.4 percent to 3.0.
evidence.title: V-FiLLM: Verified Financial LLM Reasoning Benchmark
